derived.zh: 官方模型卡声明当前代 Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B 的 base_model 是 Phi-4-reasoning，而 Phi-4-reasoning 又声明派生自 phi-4（SFT + RL 微调）——整条当前代线在权重谱系上是 phi-4 的后训练产物，不是从零预训练。
derived.en: The official model card declares the current-generation Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B is based on Phi-4-reasoning, which in turn declares phi-4 as its base (SFT + RL fine-tuning) — the whole current line is a post-train lineage of phi-4, not trained from scratch.

generations.zh: 当前代：15B 视觉推理档（模型卡 base_model 指向 Phi-4-reasoning），MIT 许可；技术报告 arXiv:2511.19663。
generations.en: Current generation: the 15B vision-reasoning build (model card base_model points at Phi-4-reasoning), MIT licence; technical report arXiv:2511.19663.

generations.zh: 推理强化代：官方 README「finetuned from Phi-4 using supervised fine-tuning on a dataset of chain-of-thought traces and reinforcement learning」，上下文 32K。
generations.en: Reasoning-focused step: official README "finetuned from Phi-4 using supervised fine-tuning on a dataset of chain-of-thought traces and reinforcement learning", 32K context.

generations.zh: 基座代：phi-4 为 14B 密集 / 16K 上下文（官方 README 口径），mini 3.8B 与 multimodal 同代放出；全部 MIT。
generations.en: Base-generation step: phi-4 is 14B dense / 16K context per the official README, with the 3.8B mini and multimodal builds released alongside; all MIT.

licenses.zh: MIT（phi-4 与 reasoning 系模型卡均 license: mit，许可原文在仓内 LICENSE）
licenses.en: MIT (phi-4 and the reasoning-line model cards all say license: mit; licence text in-repo)

claims.zh: 官方 README（phi-4）：「14B parameters, dense decoder-only Transformer」「Context length: 16K tokens」；训练数据以合成数据集为主（官方明说 synthetic datasets 路线）。
claims.en: Official README (phi-4): "14B parameters, dense decoder-only Transformer"; "Context length: 16K tokens"; training leans on synthetic datasets (stated by the vendor).

claims.zh: 官方 README（Phi-4-reasoning）：「state-of-the-art open-weight reasoning model finetuned from Phi-4 using supervised fine-tuning … and reinforcement learning」「Context length: 32k tokens」。
claims.en: Official README (Phi-4-reasoning): "state-of-the-art open-weight reasoning model finetuned from Phi-4 using supervised fine-tuning … and reinforcement learning"; "Context length: 32k tokens".

positioning.zh: 微软的小尺寸高质量路线：MIT、尺寸集中在 4B–15B、官方主打「合成数据教小模型」。当前代是 reasoning-vision 线（谱系上仍是 phi-4 后训练）。本站未收其量化对比——当前代 GGUF 生态太薄（见下）。
positioning.en: Microsoft's small-but-high-quality line: MIT, sizes concentrated at 4B–15B, and the vendor's pitch is "teach small models with synthetic data". The current line is reasoning-vision (still a phi-4 post-train on the weight lineage). This site carries no quantisation comparison — the current generation's GGUF ecosystem is too thin (see below).

onSite.zh: 本站未收 Phi 的量化对比：当前代 Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B 的 GGUF 生态实测仅约 2.9k 下载（2026-10-20 HF 检索），远低于本站 ~30 万门槛；老代 phi-4 / mini 生态虽大但不是当前代，本站不采老代（收录标准第 1 条）。
onSite.en: No quantisation comparison on this site: the current Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B GGUF ecosystem measured only ~2.9k downloads (HF search 2026-10-20), far below the ~300k threshold; the older phi-4 / mini ecosystems are larger but are not the current generation, and this site does not collect older generations (collection rule #1).
